alt: Labeled exploded view: voice coil motor, aluminum mount plate, piezo sensor, test beam, cage shield and centering spring
First build of the device clamped to the machined test rig: aluminum beam on two posts over a steel base plate

The finished device on the beam, with the printed cage shield and centering spring
FEA displacement plot of the mount plate under the motor's 15 N peak force
Control loop: negative acceleration feedback drives PWM to the voice coil motor, which acts on the beam, which the piezo sensor measures

Simulation output showing the controller's position command coming out jagged and slower than the beam
